estimand: p(actor answer Y | assigned reference role/profile, legally visible history, common current state, proposed B relative to frozen A)
actor_is: a recruited human enacting the given reference household; not a member of the original CHFS donor
population_anchor: 2020 mainland China city ordinary-residential family households; exclude towns, rural, collective and nonordinary dwellings
episodes: ten fixed reference dates; independent physical histories, chronological legal actor history; no fabricated actual longitudinal household
A: usual feasible given plan from independent service need and shared resources, frozen before B
B: retained counterfactual requests including bad/inconvenient/near-boundary/negotiable/cross-device conditions; actor judges
labels: binary adoption, four optional ratings, explanation from original frontend; all absent before real collection
model: one global role-conditioned model with a total human feedback budget; no per-household adapters or identity lookup
formal_evaluation: group source-motif and roster dependencies, keep all dates and A/B of a world together; training/calibration/heldout answers separate; no identities or current/future answers in stimulation
production_gate: actual content closure and scientific review; original50 verification, no full1000 launch by default
human_gate: readability and role-information prepilot and independent heldout labels before collection/training/formal benchmark claims
